committee: Joint Agriculture, State and Public Lands & Water Resources
location: Sheridan College Whitney Center for the Arts, Classrooms 235-236 1 Whitney Way
title: The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Committee's interim work. The Committee will consider a bill draft to revise the Veterinary Practice Act to allow laypersons to perform pregnancy examinations on cattle and sheep. The Committee will also consider draft legislation that would require fencing to prevent livestock trespass from federal lands onto private property and imposing liability on livestock owners.
